title: Joseph Far From Home
themeTags: God is with me in hard places
reflectionQuestion: When everything felt wrong and Joseph was far from home, he was never really alone — God stayed right beside him in the dark. When have you felt a little bit alone, and who helps you remember God is close?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Joseph in Egypt, Genesis 39-40) -- fills the missing middle of the Joseph arc between the coat (Gen 37) and Pharaoh's dreams (Gen 41, existing kid_joseph_dreams). Mood=anxious; routes a child far-from-home / facing unfairness. WATCH: the not-alone thread -- 'God was with Joseph' through slavery + prison; God-with-not-cause (God didn't cause the betrayal/prison, stayed WITH him, working quietly for good). Injustice named in one calm line ('blamed for something he did not do'), never dwelt on. Ends BEFORE the rise (that's kid_joseph_dreams). Indelible image: God beside Joseph in the dark prison. Voice TBC at audio (proposed VOICE_DAVID_SHEPHERD).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
